# fetch all outbox threads matching an exact subject keyword

def fetch_all_outbox_threads(query, page_limit=20):
    all_threads=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page = apis.gmail.show_outbox_threads(access_token=gmail_access_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

            break
        all_threads.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
        if len(page) < page_limit:

        if page_index > 50:

import re

pw = {x['account_name']: x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
self_email = profile['email']

gmail_access_token = apis.gmail.login(username=profile['email'], password=pw['gmail'])['access_token']
thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(access_token=gmail_access_token, email_thread_id=47820)

print('Thread id:', thread['email_thread_id'])
print('Self email:', self_email)

expenses_pattern = re.compile(r'Flight Expense:\s*(\d+)\s*Accommodation Expense:\s*(\d+)\s*Meals Expense:\s*(\d+)', re.I)

rows = []
for email in thread['emails']:
    sender_email = email['sender']['email']
    sender_name = email['sender']['name']
    body = email['body'] or ''
    if sender_email.lower() == self_email.lower():
        print('Skipping self email from:', sender_name, sender_email)
        continue
    m = expenses_pattern.search(body.replace('\n',' '))
    if not m:
        # try separate patterns
        flight_m = re.search(r'Flight Expense:\s*(\d+)', body, re.I)
        acc_m = re.search(r'Accommodation Expense:\s*(\d+)', body, re.I)
        meal_m = re.search(r'Meals Expense:\s*(\d+)', body, re.I)
        print('No combined match for:', sender_name, sender_email, 'found', bool(flight_m), bool(acc_m), bool(meal_m))
        if flight_m and acc_m and meal_m:
            flight = int(flight_m.group(1)); acc=int(acc_m.group(1)); meals=int(meal_m.group(1))
        else:
            raise ValueError(f'Could not parse expenses for {sender_name} ({sender_email})')
    else:
        flight = int(m.group(1)); acc=int(m.group(2)); meals=int(m.group(3))

    first_name = sender_name.split()[0]
    rows.append((first_name, flight, acc, meals))

print('Extracted rows:', len(rows))
print(rows)

# sort by first name
rows_sorted = sorted(rows, key=lambda x: x[0].lower())
print('Sorted rows:', rows_sorted)

header = 'Person First Name,Flight Expense (Integer),Accommodation Expense (Integer),Meals Expense (Integer)'
content = header + '\n' + '\n'.join([f"{fn},{fl},{ac},{me}" for fn,fl,ac,me in rows_sorted])

print('Preview content:\n', content)

# read existing file to confirm header only
pw = {x['account_name']: x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username=apis.supervisor.show_profile()['email'], password=pw['file_system'])['access_token']
old = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path='~/documents/work/expense_reimbursements.csv', access_token=fs_token)
print('Old content:\n', old['content'])

# update file
resp = apis.file_system.update_file(file_path='~/documents/work/expense_reimbursements.csv', content=content, access_token=fs_token)
print('Update response:', resp)

# verify readback
newf = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path='~/documents/work/expense_reimbursements.csv', access_token=fs_token)
print('New content:\n', newf['content'])
